E_FAB.fact_summary_en: TPU FDM beams; resin SLA connectors/supports; glued assembly; lubricated sleeve interiors; macroscale 12 normal plus 2 small signal elements.

E_SIGNAL.fact_summary_en: Above the connector-center datum is logic0, below is logic1; monostable signals return after load release. Twelve normal elements measured.

E_SMALL.locator: SI Note2 and Fig2a, p2 and p8
E_SMALL.fact_summary_en: Two small signal beams measured; distinct from time samples and repeated cycles.

E_MEMORY.locator: SI Note2 and Fig2c, p3 and p8
E_MEMORY.fact_summary_en: Fourteen bistable memory beams measured. Fabricated length62mm, installed support span60mm. Upward on; downward off.

E_NOR.fact_summary_en: Three signal elements; input excitation precedes output; voltage chosen to straddle constrained/unconstrained thresholds, numeric voltage absent.

E_ARRAY.fact_summary_en: Signal and matching memory are series pairs; row branches switch sequentially. At most three active rows. Same ReMM reused by instruction changes and AU initialization.

E_GATES.fact_summary_en: Physical NOT, OR, AND reuse same ReMM; each has a distinct instruction mask and truth-table alternatives.

E_ROUTING.fact_summary_en: Defective routing physically demonstrated; a normal signal beam is replaced by two small beams for parity bridging. Perfect routing is explanatory Fig5a.

E_VOLATILE.fact_summary_en: Two adjacent elements in different maintained rows store state when upstream signals release. One held element is insufficient to retain logic0.

E_MECHANICAL.locator: SI Note4 and Fig5d, p5 and p11
E_MECHANICAL.fact_summary_en: Photographed three-element purely mechanical NOR proof; mechanical memory blocks or exposes loading-bar passage. Roller-array figure is schematic.

E_MESO.fact_summary_en: Projection micro-stereolithography in UTL resin produced mesoscale elements; not a tested mesoscale computing array.

E_FEM.locator: Methods finite elements; main Fig1c,2c,4c,5b comparisons; SI Note1/Fig1 and Fig2a,b,d numerical curves
E_FEM.fact_summary_en: FEM uses fitted72MPa modulus and connector/spring approximations; modeling input is not hardware calibration.

E_NAND.fact_summary_en: Numerical NAND with5N excitation; force thresholds are numerical, not electromagnet operating settings.

E_PLANAR.fact_summary_en: Numerical alternate planar NOR; LIGA and micromachining proposed, not performed.

E_HALF.fact_summary_en: Half adder explicitly numerical-only for four input cases.

E_CROSS.fact_summary_en: Numerical large crossover176 elements; separate from compact layout.

E_COMPACT.fact_summary_en: Numerical compact crossover25 elements with two clock phases.

E_LATCH.fact_summary_en: Numerical/theoretical S-R latch four clock phases; S=R=1 invalid for normal use.

E_SEQ.fact_summary_en: Two-instruction sequential-logic strategy is schematic; storage experiment alone does not validate full sequential apparatus.

E_FAB.fact_summary_en: TPU FDM beams; resin SLA connectors/supports; glued assembly; lubricated sleeve interiors; macroscale 12 normal plus 2 small signal elements.

E_SIGNAL.fact_summary_en: Above the connector-center datum is logic0, below is logic1; monostable signals return after load release. Twelve normal elements measured.

E_SMALL.locator: SI Note2 and Fig2a, p2 and p8
E_SMALL.fact_summary_en: Two small signal beams measured; distinct from time samples and repeated cycles.

E_MEMORY.locator: SI Note2 and Fig2c, p3 and p8
E_MEMORY.fact_summary_en: Fourteen bistable memory beams measured. Fabricated length62mm, installed support span60mm. Upward on; downward off.

E_NOR.fact_summary_en: Three signal elements; input excitation precedes output; voltage chosen to straddle constrained/unconstrained thresholds, numeric voltage absent.

E_ARRAY.fact_summary_en: Signal and matching memory are series pairs; row branches switch sequentially. At most three active rows. Same ReMM reused by instruction changes and AU initialization.

E_GATES.fact_summary_en: Physical NOT, OR, AND reuse same ReMM; each has a distinct instruction mask and truth-table alternatives.

E_ROUTING.fact_summary_en: Defective routing physically demonstrated; a normal signal beam is replaced by two small beams for parity bridging. Perfect routing is explanatory Fig5a.

E_VOLATILE.fact_summary_en: Two adjacent elements in different maintained rows store state when upstream signals release. One held element is insufficient to retain logic0.

E_MECHANICAL.locator: SI Note4 and Fig5d, p5 and p11
E_MECHANICAL.fact_summary_en: Photographed three-element purely mechanical NOR proof; mechanical memory blocks or exposes loading-bar passage. Roller-array figure is schematic.

E_MESO.fact_summary_en: Projection micro-stereolithography in UTL resin produced mesoscale elements; not a tested mesoscale computing array.

E_FEM.locator: Methods finite elements; main Fig1c,2c,4c,5b comparisons; SI Note1/Fig1 and Fig2a,b,d numerical curves
E_FEM.fact_summary_en: FEM uses fitted72MPa modulus and connector/spring approximations; modeling input is not hardware calibration.

E_NAND.fact_summary_en: Numerical NAND with5N excitation; force thresholds are numerical, not electromagnet operating settings.

E_PLANAR.fact_summary_en: Numerical alternate planar NOR; LIGA and micromachining proposed, not performed.

E_HALF.fact_summary_en: Half adder explicitly numerical-only for four input cases.

E_CROSS.fact_summary_en: Numerical large crossover176 elements; separate from compact layout.

E_COMPACT.fact_summary_en: Numerical compact crossover25 elements with two clock phases.

E_LATCH.fact_summary_en: Numerical/theoretical S-R latch four clock phases; S=R=1 invalid for normal use.

E_SEQ.fact_summary_en: Two-instruction sequential-logic strategy is schematic; storage experiment alone does not validate full sequential apparatus.

membership; occurrences and precedence supplied by dependencies and qualified episode schedule, not historical chronology
Reported physical inventory is not an episode default. FDM beam and SLA rigid part jobs have independent occurrence IDs and process cards.

Every required nonempty scheduled condition has immutable,classified observations and required control/reset/custody/cleanup receipts. Failed scientific agreement and incomplete acquisition are distinct.
Prepared-state receipt carries object IDs,revisions,location,energy state,calibration scope and outstanding terminal work. Verify before downstream reuse; never assume prebuilt state.
Memory preparation is an authored gated closure. Detailed memory fabrication recipe is unspecified; do not assume every signal-element recipe transfers.
Finite specimen and cycle allocation required. Curve samples,truth cases,cycles and replacement specimens have separate identities.

No unsupported requirement that every historical test preceded assembly. Qualification evidence or explicit qualified handoff is needed; normal/small/memory measurement campaigns remain separately required for whole-paper coverage.

Input cases are alternatives with a verified reset between independent attempts. Reprogram persistent ReIM separately from transient AU reset. Shared system reuse is source-reported; exact specimen chronology is not.

Exact branching destinations and active mask require source/geometry resolution. Perfect Fig5a topology remains explanatory, not a second asserted physical experiment. Existing12-normal+2-small AU may already contain the bridge. Conversion counts describe a topology transaction,not extra default components.

Fig7b case inventory and positions are unresolved until main panels inspected. Read/rewrite by transmission is source-described; only Fig7a–c retention is asserted physical. Clearing requires a new hold epoch before another write.
Proof-specific mechanical memory and loading components require separate qualified input cards. No roller,belt or gear array fabrication is claimed.
Fabrication-only demonstration. No functional mesoscale logic or MEMS replication.
